MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink bundle feels like a natural next choice because it adds doorbell coverage and more cameras to the Blink setup I already started.",
    "The Echo Dot offers a useful new way to control my Fire TV devices, so it complements equipment I own.",
    "The endurance memory card could support my video recording needs, although I would need to confirm compatibility and capacity. The Ring camera also fits my interest in battery-powered security, but expanding Blink appeals more."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The HD Fire TV Stick adds little because I already own a 4K stick and a Fire TV television. Apple TV also duplicates a streaming need I have already covered.",
    "My interest in television entertainment does not mean I currently want a tablet for portable viewing.",
    "Owning a camcorder does not mean I need a four-input capture card for desktop broadcasting. The access point and keyboard combo likewise address needs I have not expressed."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire TV purchases seem to have been treated as a reason to suggest more streaming devices, without considering what another device would add.",
    "My camera and electronics purchases seem to have been stretched into an interest in specialized recording equipment and general computer accessories."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Building on my existing Blink setup matters more to me than finding another security camera with similar features.",
    "I am more interested in additions that provide a new capability, such as doorbell coverage or hands-free control, than replacements for functions I already have.",
    "Accessories only become compelling when they fit my specific equipment and actual storage or recording needs."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognize my interest in home security and Fire TV entertainment, but miss the distinction between useful additions and equipment that duplicates existing functions or serves an unrelated need."
}
